_doc: Everything you can smash (scripts/match/breakables.gd). Any single hit breaks a breakable: a shot, a melee swing, an ability, a Boki strike, a blast or a dash through it; none has a health pool. 'weight' is the share of the random scatter on a map. 'material' picks the debris and the break sound, and 'chunks' how many bits it throws (thinned by the quality preset, capped by BreakFx.DEBRIS_CAP). 'debris' per material: a cel particle 'look' (shaders/hero_vfx_mote.gdshader: wood splinters, clay sherds, metal glints), 'colors' [lit, edge, shade], 'size' m, 'speed' m/s, 'life' s (under 1: gone before the next swing). 'loot' is rolled when it breaks: gems [min, max] worth gem_base each, odds for a tonic, armor shards (armor_amount) and a seed, and 'table' names a gear drop table. An 'explosive' kind is lit by its hit instead, burns 'fuse' seconds (or 'chain_fuse' when another blast lit it) with a ground ring showing 'radius', then blows: 'damage' at the middle falling to half at the edge, knockback and lift in m/s.
